name: Fairmont La Marina Rabat Sale
positioning: Fairmont La Marina Rabat-Salé: a hotel designed to mirror a cruise liner at anchor where the Bouregreg River meets the Atlantic, facing the Marina of Salé
best_for: Travelers who want estuary and ocean views 10 minutes from Rabat city center
Groups or families wanting a large suite with a big private terrace

facts.text: The hotel sits at the confluence of the Bouregreg River and the Atlantic Ocean.
The hotel is on Fes Avenue, in front of the Marina of Salé, 10 minutes from Rabat city center and a 20-minute drive from Rabat International Airport.
Its open, interconnected spaces blend traditional craftsmanship and Moroccan artistry with modern materials.
Rooms have bay windows and views of the estuary.
Fairmont rooms have a workspace fusing historical details with contemporary items crafted by local artists.
Fairmont View rooms have a balcony overlooking the twin cities and a bathroom with an Italian shower and a bathtub.
The Heritage Gold Suite has a private terrace of over 65 square meters with a view of the Kasbah.
Fairmont Gold rooms give access to the Fairmont Gold lounge with sea views, serving breakfast, afternoon canapés and evening hors d'oeuvres.
The hotel has a rooftop pool and a fitness center.
The rooftop offers a Greek-inspired, Mediterranean dining experience with sea breeze.
The hotel offers a Rabat night city tour showing illuminated landmarks.
There is underground parking with electric-car charging terminals and a valet parking service.

highlights.text: The building is designed to mirror a cruise liner dropping anchor on the estuary.
The three-bedroom Ambassador Gold Suite has a terrace of over 162 square meters and pays tribute to HRH Princess Lalla Aicha, the first female ambassador in the Arab world.
The Ocean Suite has a 43-square-meter private terrace looking out at the confluence of the Bouregreg River and the Atlantic Ocean.
The spa offers a Hammam experience using marocMaroc products.
The head concierge, Jaafar, is a Clés d'Or concierge.

considerations.text: The hotel faces the Marina of Salé and is 10 minutes from Rabat city center; Casablanca International Airport is 1 hour 30 minutes away.
WhataHotel notes the marina setting may feel isolated from the historic city center.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
